description: Source code for managing HUD elements in the Unvanquished game, including loading, showing, hiding, and clearing HUD units and scoreboards.

classes.name: HudUnit
classes.description: Represents a HUD element unit, holding a reference to its document and load state.

methods.name: Rocket_InitializeHuds
methods.description: Initializes the HUD list with a specified size, clearing previous HUDs.

methods.name: Rocket_LoadUnit
methods.description: Loads a HUD unit from a specified path and manages its document state.

methods.name: Rocket_AddUnitToHud
methods.description: Adds a HUD unit identified by an ID to a specific weapon's HUD list.

methods.name: Rocket_ShowHud
methods.description: Displays the HUD for a specific weapon, hiding others and managing unit load states.

methods.name: Rocket_ClearHud
methods.description: Clears all HUD units associated with a specific weapon.

methods.name: Rocket_ShowScoreboard
methods.description: Shows or hides a scoreboard document by name.
